understanding.goal_understanding: Solve each level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; when all goals are covered simultaneously the level reports WIN, and completing all levels wins the game within the per-level step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Only the currently selected piece responds to actions. Movement is constrained by walls/obstacles and other pieces (they block movement), so attempts that would pass through or land in blocked spaces have no effect. Arrow actions (e.g., MOVE_RIGHT) move the selected piece along that direction until it stops at the nearest valid stopping point (often the next obstacle/boundary). CLICK on a target tile attempts to move the selected piece to the clicked position (typically along a straight line/clear corridor); if the path or destination is blocked, the piece does not move.
